source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 3 (ISL A3) · lesson 24. Rewritten for children from Dr. Hassan's lesson; facts and references kept.

learn.en: ʿAlī was the son of Abu Ṭālib — the Prophet's cousin. He grew up in the Prophet's home.
learn.title: The Prophet's cousin

learn.en: He was one of the very first to accept Islam, when he was only a boy.
learn.title: A young believer

learn.en: He married the Prophet's daughter Fāṭimah. Their sons al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn were the Prophet's beloved grandsons.
learn.title: His family

learn.en: ʿAlī was known for knowledge, courage and justice. Later he became the fourth rightly-guided caliph.
learn.title: Knowledge and courage

learn.en: At Ḥudaybiyah, the Prophet ﷺ asked him to erase the words “Messenger of Allah” from a paper. ʿAlī said: “No, by Allah, I will never erase you.” (Bukhari 2699)
learn.title: His love for the Prophet ﷺ

quiz.en: How was ʿAlī related to the Prophet ﷺ?
True or false? ʿAlī believed in Islam when he was a boy.
True or false? ʿAlī was known for courage and knowledge.

think.q: ʿAlī believed when he was young. What good thing can YOU start while you are young?
think.a: Praying on time, learning Qur'an, being honest — the earlier you start, the stronger you grow.

parents.summary: ʿAlī, the Prophet's cousin, grew up in his home, believed as a boy, married Fāṭimah, and was known for knowledge and courage.
parents.tip: Tell the Ḥudaybiyah story and ask: “What shows ʿAlī's love?”
